title: LearnFromX JLPT-style N5-N1
author: LearnFromX
description: JLPT-style level (N5-N1) for 18,000+ words, extended from Jonathan Waller's lists. The JLPT has not published a word list since 2010, so these levels are an estimate.
attribution:
Levels: LearnFromX JLPT-style vocabulary list (https://learnfromx.com), based on Jonathan Waller's JLPT Resources (http://www.tanos.co.uk/jlpt/, CC BY) and JMdict by the Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group (https://www.edrdg.org/, CC BY-SA 4.0).
